citations.B1: Check-then-act race — `get` then `counts[user_id] = count + 1` is not atomic
citations.B3: fix with a lock around read-modify-write or an atomic increment
citations.B4: No time window — counts never reset, so this is a lifetime quota, not a rate limit
citations.B5: Unbounded memory growth — one permanent entry per distinct `user_id`
citations.B6: Per-process state — each worker has its own `counts`, so the real limit is `limit × workers`
citations.B7: `user_id` unvalidated — `None` buckets every anonymous caller together, and an unhashable ID raises `TypeError`
